notes: New text layers now get the SAME clean inspector as the main text. In the Timeline editor, selecting the main text showed the clean CapCut inspector (font, colour, glow, size, style, align, position, wrap), but selecting an added text layer dumped you into the raw accordion instead. buildTimelineInspector is now layer-aware: selecting an extra text layer builds the identical clean inspector, wired through to that layer's fields via layer-aware tlInsp* handlers (which dispatch to the existing setExtra*/saveExtraText for extra layers, unchanged for main). 'All controls' / 'Back' keep the selected layer. Main text behaviour is unchanged.
